verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipelines orchestrated with Apache Airflow, which are time-based triggers rather than event rules. It also claims "built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts," a thin hint at automatic actions on pipeline events. Nothing shows user-definable event-to-action rules. missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule engine for event-based triggers, configurable actions beyond alerts, documentation of which events can trigger actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
